== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 29 April 2026. The Facebook photo viewer names Jeff Brueggeman. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 6 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Champaign, Il). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/jeff.brueggeman and does not list a hometown. The uncropped original is a beach photograph with a Pluto mascot; the lead crop is Brueggeman.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Jeff Brueggeman portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Jeff Brueggeman Facebook portrait.jpg]].
